_meta.purpose: Skeleton example of a classic_multifactor daily-rebalance config (S3b).
_meta.status: skeleton — no real backtest baseline yet (Task 7 / S5 will produce one)
notes: loop_mode MUST be 'daily'; intraday-only fields (max_intraday_trades, entry_cooldown_minutes, min_hold_minutes, no_new_entry_after, signal_interval_minutes) are rejected by config_schema.validate_loop_mode.
rebalance_time uses the runner's --session-tz (default America/New_York) and triggers a single one-shot pass per day.
max_daily_turnover bounds daily_new_pct in the LiveRiskGuard.
target_positions is a free-form mapping consumed by run_daily_rebalance.py; for the current skeleton it is just a single-symbol pass-through and only one symbol is rebalanced per run.
